title: Calvin Neff Round Barn, PA Route 45, Centre Hall, Centre County, PA
notes: Significance: The Calvin Neff Round Barn was built in 1910 by farmer Calvin Neff and carpenter Aaron Thomas.  Round barn designs were promoted during the late nineteenth century for agricultural labor saving and efficient use of space.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 79002181
